name: @s2/s2rb-desktop
description: S2RB desktop client for Windows and macOS. Tray resident, local SQLite only.

scripts.dev: npm run check:env && npm run icons && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run check:env && npm run icons && npm run export:ui && tauri build
scripts.build:dmg: npm run check:env && npm run icons && npm run export:ui && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.build:exe: npm run check:env && npm run icons && npm run export:ui && tauri build --bundles nsis
